text:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] inference-kvcache - KV cache miss rate spike on prod (>=20% for 5m). Increased tail latency observed. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.dev/d/kvcache/prod?orgId=1&from=now-30m  Paging @ashley (oncall)

ashley: On it. Acknowledging and joining. Moving this thread to #incident-live. Anyone seeing related errors or deployment activity?

miguel: I see a burst from eu-west-1 hitting model-router, tail latency up. Correlates with the miss spike. No recent code deploys in the last hour.

sam: No deploys from infra in last 60m. Autoscaler looks stable from metrics.

lina: Logs show lots of "cache-key-not-found" spikes around 16:34 UTC. Looks like a purge or expired snapshot. Could be namespace purge for prompt-cache.

ashley: Miguel can you list top missing prefixes, please? Run this quick check:
```bash
curl -s 'https://api-prod.redwood/samples/kvcache/top-missing?window=10m' | jq .
```

miguel: Quick output pasted: top prefixes -> ["session:", "user-profiles:", "prompt-cache:"]  Majority are prompt-cache entries. Seems like a purge job triggered. :eyes:

sre-bot: Note: paging rotation -> @ashley (oncall). Severity: P2 (customer latency impact). Related runbook: https://runbook.redwood.dev/oncall/kvcache-miss

ashley: I'll own mitigation. Sam/Lina can one of you try re-warming prompt-cache from snapshot? Sam, can you run warm job?

sam: Starting re-warm job. Command I'm running now:
```
kubectl exec -n infra kvcache-warm -- ./warm --namespace prompt-cache --parallel 8
```
ETA ~6min. Posting logs to incident channel.

lina: I'll start an alert-tuning draft. This rule is noisy for bursty traffic. Proposal: bump miss-rate threshold 20% -> 35% (5m window) and add a 10m suppression after a successful warm. Also add an automatic dashboard annotation when we detect a purge event.

ashley: Good plan. Also update runbook to include "re-warm from snapshot" step + owner. ops-runbook-bot, can you create a stub and add ownership?

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook edit stub created: https://runbook.redwood.dev/oncall/kvcache-miss/edit/0.1  Added field oncall_team: eng-oncall. Please review and append the warm command and expected behavior.

miguel: Re-warm job ~40% through, miss rate trending down from 22% -> 12% at 16:41 UTC.

ashley: Quick customer impact snapshot: sample shows ~6% of requests experienced latency >1s during peak window. No SLO breach yet but margin tight. Adding to post-incident doc.

sam: Warm finished successfully. Miss rate stabilized at ~4%. Tail latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

ashley: Action items to capture now:
- lina: open alert-tuning PR with threshold bump + suppression + dashboard annotation. Assign to eng-monitoring.
- miguel: paste metric samples and the top-prefix output into the timeline.
- sam: paste warm job output and exact commands into the runbook step.

lina: Creating PR and ticket now. Ticket: https://issues.redwood.dev/PROD-1422 (alert tuning + dashboard annotation). PR: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/monitoring/pulls/678

ashley: I'll hold the page for 15m then close if stable. Also adding a retro note: consider canarying cache-invalidation/purge jobs and add stronger annotations when a purge runs.

product-alerts: FYI product is scheduling a follow-up sync tomorrow to review customer impact and potential product-level mitigations (cc: @ashley @lina). :calendar:

ashley: Runbook updated with the new warm step, command snippet, and ownership. Edit link: https://runbook.redwood.dev/oncall/kvcache-miss/0.1  Please review and ack.

miguel: ack. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident resolved and marked in timeline. Duration: 00:12:59. Closing page.
